description: Requirements 03 (A, B, C) and 04 - redesign the RIGHT side of the map in VayuLokLive.tsx, aligned to the homepage design system. 03A: rounded borders on the map surface. 03B: center the search bar horizontally over the map with space at the top, give it a clear inner or outer border, and keep autocomplete on the Google Maps India SKU (the modern Places AutocompleteSuggestion Data API already wired, India-scoped). 03C: when an area is selected, show only that area's geocoding, and make the map expandable via drag and/or keyboard interaction (in the spirit of Google's Destinations demo + the Geocoding 'search for destinations' docs) while respecting India bounds and keeping Google attribution insets visible. 04: match the homepage CSS/UI/UX/color theme (home tokens in src/pages/index.tsx styled-jsx and .agents/tasks/vayulok-home-aligned-mock/design-tokens.md). All markup must stay INLINE in the component return (styled-jsx scoping gotcha). This feature builds on FEAT-002, which removed the preview place card and relocated the photo pill. Preserve honest degradation (no key -> no map, zero fetches) and never commit or hardcode a key.
steps: Read the current map markup/CSS in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx: the return block .vl-live-map-sticky > .vl-live-map-stage (with .vl-live-map-fallback, .vl-live-map-canvas, .vl-live-map-search, .vl-live-map-controls) and the styled-jsx rules .vl-live-map-stage, .vl-live-map-canvas, .vl-live-map-fallback, .vl-live-map-search, .vl-live-search, .vl-live-search-field, .vl-live-search-input, .vl-live-search-results. Also re-read the map init useEffect (the new maps.Map({...}) options) and the geocoder click handler.

03A - rounded borders: ensure the map surface has rounded corners consistent with the home radii. .vl-live-map-stage already uses border-radius:14px (the home panel radius) and .vl-live-map-canvas uses border-radius:inherit; confirm this and, if the owner intent (and the user's 'make the borders rounded') calls for a more pronounced radius matching the removed preview card's 20px feel, apply a single consistent panel radius from the allowed set {14px, 20px} across .vl-live-map-stage, .vl-live-map-canvas, and .vl-live-map-fallback so the whole map reads as one rounded panel. Do not introduce radii outside the home token set.

03B - center the search bar on the map with top space: change .vl-live-map-search from top-left (top:16px;left:16px) to horizontally centered over the map with a top offset (e.g. top:16-20px, left:50%, transform:translateX(-50%), a max-width so it does not span edge-to-edge), and keep it above the canvas (z-index). Keep the field's clear border: the existing .vl-live-search-field already has a 2px solid #1a3a2a outer border with a lime focus ring and backdrop blur (matching the shipped BlogSearch field and home control-border rule: border is #1a3a2a NOT lime); keep that as the 'outer border' the requirement asks for, and keep the input neutralised against the global inner-pages.css/Dashboard.css input:focus box (the !important resets that prevent a second inner box). Update the .vl-live-map-controls / search-results / responsive @media(max-width:1023px/767px) offsets so the centered search bar and the AQI/PM2.5 controls and photo overlay (from FEAT-002) do not overlap. Verify the search-results dropdown still anchors under the centered field.

03B - autocomplete stays on the India SKU: do NOT change the search data path - it already uses lib.AutocompleteSuggestion.fetchAutocompleteSuggestions with a per-session AutocompleteSessionToken and India scoping (includedRegionCodes:['in'], region:'in', locationRestriction:INDIA_BOUNDS), with geocoding only as a fallback. Keep it referrer-key + client-side. If any markup move touches the combobox input/listbox, preserve role=combobox, aria-controls, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete, the onQueryChange debounce (searchTimer 300ms), onKeyDown arrow/enter/escape handling, and recent-places behavior. Document in findings that the India SKU autocomplete is unchanged by design.

03C - selected area shows only its geocoding: when a place is selected (via search choose() or map click reverse-geocode), ensure the map presents only that area's geocoded location - recenter on the selected lat/lng and keep the single marker for that area (the existing recenter effect sets center+zoom 14 and moves the marker). Confirm no stale candidate/preview geocoding lingers now that the preview card is gone; keep the mapCandidate click->reverse-geocode flow only insofar as it still drives selecting an area (if the preview card that displayed candidate data was removed in FEAT-002, make the map click directly select/geocode the area or cleanly no-op, with no unused state). Keep region:'in' and INDIA_BOUNDS on all geocoding.

03C - expandable map via drag + keyboard: introduce an expand interaction so the map can grow (e.g. a larger/expanded stage height or an expanded mode) and support drag plus keyboard interaction similar to the referenced Google demos. Concretely: (a) keep gestureHandling:'greedy' so drag-pan works; (b) the current options set keyboardShortcuts:false and disableDefaultUI:true which disables Google's built-in keyboard panning - to honor 'keyboard interactions', EITHER enable keyboardShortcuts (set to true) so arrow-key pan/zoom works when the map is focused, OR add an explicit accessible expand/collapse control (a button, keyboard-operable via Enter/Space, with aria-expanded) that toggles an expanded map stage; choose one approach, keep it client-side, and document the choice in findings. Respect India bounds: keep restriction {latLngBounds:INDIA_BOUNDS, strictBounds:true} so drag/zoom cannot leave India. Keep Google attribution insets visible (no .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google] targeting; overlays stay inset from bottom corners even in expanded mode).

04 - homepage design alignment: style every new/changed element with the home tokens (Inter; lime #d1f470 fill with #1a3a2a type; control border #1a3a2a; hairline #e5e7eb 1px static / 2px hoverable; radii only {14px/20px panel, 999px/50px pill+CTA, 10px/12px field}; single hover shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,42,.12); focus ring outline:3px solid #1a3a2a with 2-3px offset). NO RED and no non-palette colors anywhere. Any new expand control should reuse the existing pill/CTA styling language already present (.vl-live-layer / .vl-live-solar-load / .vl-live-view-details patterns) so it matches the page and the home page.

Update src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx to track the changes and stay green: the India-scoping test reads rec.mapOpts and asserts restriction.strictBounds===true, disableDefaultUI===true, fullscreenControl/mapTypeControl/streetViewControl===false, and keyboardShortcuts===false. If 03C changes keyboardShortcuts to true, UPDATE that assertion to the new intended value (and add an assertion for the chosen keyboard/expand mechanism); if instead an explicit expand button is added, keep keyboardShortcuts===false and add a test that the expand control is present and toggles (operable by keyboard). Keep the autocomplete India-scoping assertions (region 'in', includedRegionCodes ['in'], sessionToken truthy, locationRestriction bounds) passing unchanged. Keep the honest-degradation and heatmap-on-user-action tests intact. Ensure the FakeMap stub still satisfies any new map method calls (addListener etc.) the component makes.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test and fix any failures.
acceptance_criteria: The map surface (stage/canvas/fallback) reads as one rounded panel using only home-token radii; no square corners remain on the map.

The search bar is horizontally centered over the map with visible top spacing, retains a clear border (outer #1a3a2a border + lime focus ring, no stray inner box), and does not overlap the layer controls or the relocated photo pill at desktop and mobile widths.
Autocomplete still uses the Google Maps India SKU (AutocompleteSuggestion Data API, India-scoped, session token) client-side; the India-scoping assertions in the test suite pass.
Selecting an area recenters the map on that area's geocoded location with a single marker and no leftover/unused candidate state; all geocoding stays region:'in' + INDIA_BOUNDS.

The map supports drag panning and a keyboard interaction (either enabled keyboardShortcuts or an accessible keyboard-operable expand control), the map can be expanded, and India bounds (strictBounds) plus Google attribution insets remain enforced; the chosen approach is recorded in findings.
All new/changed styles use homepage tokens with NO red and no non-palette colors; new controls reuse the page's pill/CTA styling.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run test` all pass; the map-options test reflects the intended final option values.
Honest degradation (no NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY -> no map, zero fetches, no .vl-live-map-canvas) is preserved and its test still passes; no key is hardcoded anywhere.
